SELECT w.id, w.buyer_id AS buyerId, u.username AS buyerName, u.buyer_rating_score AS buyerRatingScore, w.title, w.author, w.category_id AS categoryId, w.budget, w.desired_condition AS desiredCondition, w.expected_location AS expectedLocation, w.description, w.status, w.created_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN #{currentUserId} IS NOT NULL AND w.buyer_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isOwner FROM wanted_request w LEFT JOIN user u ON w.buyer_id = u.id WHERE w.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( w.status = 1 OR (#{currentUserId} IS NOT NULL AND w.buyer_id = #{currentUserId}) )
AND ( w.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR w.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR w.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND w.category_id = #{query.categoryId}
AND w.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{currentUserId} IS NOT NULL AND w.buyer_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, w.budget ASC

ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{currentUserId} IS NOT NULL AND w.buyer_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, w.created_at ASC

SELECT w.id, w.buyer_id AS buyerId, u.username AS buyerName, u.buyer_rating_score AS buyerRatingScore, u.buyer_rating_count AS buyerRatingCount, w.title, w.author, w.category_id AS categoryId, w.budget, w.desired_condition AS desiredCondition, w.expected_location AS expectedLocation, w.description, CASE WHEN #{currentUserId} IS NOT NULL AND (#{currentUserId} = w.buyer_id) THEN w.contact_phone ELSE NULL END AS contactPhone, w.status, w.close_reason AS closeReason, w.closed_at AS closedAt, w.created_at AS createdAt, w.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM wanted_request w LEFT JOIN user u ON w.buyer_id = u.id WHERE w.id = #{id} AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( w.status = 1 OR (#{currentUserId} IS NOT NULL AND w.buyer_id = #{currentUserId}) )

SELECT w.id, w.buyer_id AS buyerId, w.title, w.author, w.category_id AS categoryId, w.budget, w.desired_condition AS desiredCondition, w.expected_location AS expectedLocation, w.description, w.contact_phone AS contactPhone, w.status, w.close_reason AS closeReason, w.closed_at AS closedAt, w.created_at AS createdAt, w.updated_at AS updatedAt, w.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM wanted_request w WHERE w.id = #{id} AND w.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE wanted_request SET status = 2, close_reason = #{closeReason}, closed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND buyer_id = #{buyerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS bookId, b.seller_id AS sellerId, u.username AS sellerName, u.seller_rating_score AS sellerRatingScore, b.title, b.author, b.category_id AS categoryId, b.price, SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.cover_image, ',', 1) AS coverImg, b.preferred_location AS preferredLocation FROM wanted_request w INNER JOIN book b ON b.status = 1 AND b.is_banned = 0 AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( w.desired_condition IS NULL OR w.desired_condition = '' OR w.desired_condition = '不限' OR (w.desired_condition = '全新' AND b.book_condition = 1) OR (w.desired_condition = '九成新及以上' AND b.book_condition IN (1, 2)) OR (w.desired_condition = '八成新及以上' AND b.book_condition IN (1, 2, 3)) OR (w.desired_condition = '有正常使用痕迹' AND b.book_condition IN (1, 2, 3, 4)) ) AND ( b.category_id = w.category_id OR b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', w.title, '%') OR (w.author IS NOT NULL AND w.author != '' AND b.author LIKE CONCAT('%', w.author, '%')) ) AND b.price <= w.budget LEFT JOIN user u ON b.seller_id = u.id WHERE w.id = #{wantedId} AND w.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
